issues.description: SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int) is specified as a public method in the UML diagram, but the provided solution implements it with package-private visibility (no access modifier). This can break tests or expected external usage that call it from outside the package and confuses students about the required API.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the method signature in SealSaloon to `public static void acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity)` (or `public void ...` if you decide to make it instance-based) to match the specified public API.

issues.description: The problem statement contains conflicting guidance about ownership of the `stock` field in SealSaloon: the UML association implies `stock` is an instance attribute of SealSaloon, while the textual requirements explicitly state that `stock` must be static and shared across all instances. This inconsistency forces students to choose between diagram and text when implementing SealSaloon.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the UML consistent with the text by marking `stock` as static in the diagram (e.g., `{static}`/underlined attribute) or remove the static requirement from the text if instance-level stock is intended.
